# HostNetGame <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

</div>


```blitzbasic
HostNetGame:Int32 game_name:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `game_name` | In | String | required | The name of the game. Joining programs have to use the same name. |

**Returns:** 2 when the game was started, 0 when it could not be, for example because the port is taken.

## Description

Starts a game on this computer as its host and waits for other programs to join it.
